details:
On vrchat.com, clicking the Launch button on any world page throws a JavaScript error and prevents instance creation.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Open any world page on vrchat.com

2. Click the Launch button

Expected result:

An instance is created successfully.

Actual result:

A JavaScript error occurs and the instance is not created.

Console error:

TypeError: can't access property "some", me[e.groupId] is undefined

Relevant stack trace (excerpt):

https://dtuitjyhwcl5y.cloudfront.net/...js

https://vrchat.com/api/1/js/app.js?variant=public&branch=main

Environment:

OS: Windows 11

Browser: Firefox

Account-specific behavior:

- Different browser: issue still occurs.

- Different VRChat account on same environment: works correctly.

Group-related behavior:

My account previously showed a group with an unusual ID-like name:

"0fe9e7d54a7e4d47a68e6600ec4e80f1" in my joined group list.

Opening the group page showed "Join Group" despite appearing as joined.

Leave Group button in client did not work.

After manually joining and leaving via website, the group disappeared,

but the Launch error still persists.
title: Launch button on world pages throws JS error and prevents instance creation
